summary.en: System call and log analyzer from the Wireshark project. The installer list includes Stratoshark-0.10.4-arm64.exe.
summary.zh-TW: Wireshark 團隊推出的系統呼叫與記錄分析工具，安裝程式清單含 Stratoshark-0.10.4-arm64.exe。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Capture drivers may differ from Wireshark's; capture was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 擷取驅動程式可能與 Wireshark 不同，未測試封包擷取。
